Metaseq = metasequoiaime/pinyin-ime-reranker (Chinese only), shown with the engine rank prior; alone 42.0 / 48.2% in (a),
71.1 / 79.4% in (b). Laya (orig.) = the untuned convaiinnovations/laya multilingual model, same prompt. Zhiyi 1.1 = fine-tuned
mmBERT-base; Zhiyi 1.2 = mmBERT-small distilled from it; Zhiyi 1.4 = the unified model, 1.2 plus a head that composes long
pinyin; Zhiyi 1.4V2 = the same structure retrained on 1.5.4's long-form web text; Zhiyi 1.5.4 = the head replaced by a decoder
that writes the sentence a character at a time. (a), (i) and (j) for 1.4, 1.4V2 and 1.5.4 are end to end in the IME engine (after
the pause); in (i) (j) Frequency is the engine composing alone and Zhiyi 1.2 picks among its sentences. (d)-(h) are a page of
word choice; 1.5.4's decoder only runs for long input after the pause, and (f) (h) include it. Accuracy: int8 on the CPU, right
words not shown count as wrong. Speed and footprint: ONNX Runtime 1.24.4, int8, the same 400 pages (context up to 128
characters), Ryzen 5 9600X / RTX 5070 Ti. In the IME, Zhiyi's weights are mapped from a local cache, so its private memory is
